prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a sideswipe while changing lanes. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1105; do not mention it.)
text:
I represent the individual injured in a motor vehicle collision that occurred when the other driver sideswiped our client while our client was changing lanes. Our client sustained injuries as a result of this incident and is now receiving medical care.

Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to this office and do not contact our client directly. If your insured or any representative of your company wishes to discuss the claim, they should do so only through counsel.

We request that you provide the bodily injury and property damage limits of all policies that may apply to this loss, including any excess or umbrella coverage, along with the declarations pages.

We also ask that your company preserve all evidence relating to this collision, including photographs, vehicle data, dashcam or telematics records, recorded statements, claim notes, and any repair or inspection reports. Please confirm in writing that these materials will be retained while this claim is pending.
